description: Zero-hardcoding generic domain architectural rules matrix across server, storage, and networking platforms

rules.name: High-TDP Processor & Accelerator Cooling Capability
rules.description: Processors exceeding standard TDP (>205W) or presence of dense GPU accelerators require high-performance heatsinks and high-performance cooling fans.
rules.recommendation: Inject High-Performance Fan Kit and Performance Heat Sink Kit into server bill of materials.

rules.name: GPU Accelerator Auxiliary Power & High-Wattage PSU Mandate
rules.description: Double-wide or high-wattage PCIe GPU accelerators mandate internal GPU auxiliary power delivery cable kits and high-capacity redundant Titanium power supplies (>=2400W).
rules.recommendation: Include dedicated GPU Auxiliary Power Cable Kit and upgrade power supplies to minimum 5x 2400W Titanium PSUs.

rules.name: Storage Controller Port Limit & Expander Requirement
rules.description: Standard dedicated storage controllers address up to 8 direct-attach physical drives. Configurations exceeding 8 drives per controller require a SAS Expander or Tri-Mode Switch.
rules.recommendation: Add a SAS Expander Card or Tri-Mode Switch Card with required internal controller cables.

rules.name: Cacheless Storage Controller Parity RAID Write Risk
rules.description: Storage controllers lacking dedicated battery-backed write cache operating with parity RAID (RAID 5 or RAID 6) incur severe write latency penalties and potential data integrity risks.
rules.recommendation: Upgrade to an enterprise storage controller with >=4GB/8GB Flash-Backed Write Cache (FBWC) or deploy RAID 10.

rules.name: Disparate Drive Cage Form Factor Mutual Exclusivity
rules.description: Incompatible drive cage formats (such as 4SFF and 4EDSFF) cannot be mixed within the same contiguous drive bay zone without dedicated partitioned backplanes.
rules.recommendation: Standardize all drive bays on either SFF or EDSFF form factors to prevent mechanical and signal interference.

rules.name: Edge Server Compact Power Envelope Enforcement
rules.description: Compact edge chassis enforce physical depth and thermal power caps (<=1000W). Standard high-draw enterprise power supplies (>1000W) are physically incompatible.
rules.recommendation: Replace oversized enterprise power supplies with certified compact <=1000W edge server power supply units.

rules.name: Memory Channel Balanced Population Architecture
rules.description: Modern multi-channel memory architectures (8, 12, or 16 channels per socket) require balanced DIMM counts across active channels for maximum memory throughput and lowest latency.
rules.recommendation: Populate DIMMs in multiples matching processor channel count (e.g. 8, 12, or 16 DIMMs per socket) for optimal 1DPC bandwidth.

rules.name: PCIe Card Population & Auxiliary Riser Power Delivery
rules.description: Populating 5 or more PCIe expansion cards across primary and secondary risers mandates dedicated riser power delivery cables to supply supplemental 12V rail power.
rules.recommendation: Inject dedicated Primary/Secondary Riser Power Delivery Cable Kit to supply PCIe slot power.

rules.name: Physical Core Hypervisor & OS Licensing Multiplier
rules.description: Operating system and hypervisor platforms are licensed per physical CPU core. Total licensed cores must equal or exceed server physical core totals.
rules.recommendation: Calculate total server cores (cpuCount * coresPerCpu) and add requisite 2-core / 4-core / 16-core license add-on packs.

rules.name: Diskless Server Airflow Bypass FIO Kit
rules.description: Servers configured with 0 internal drives (boot from SAN or external fabrics) require a No-Drive FIO Enablement Kit to maintain chassis cooling airflow pressure.
rules.recommendation: Include Factory Integrated No Drive Configuration FIO Kit to pass factory configuration validation.

rules.name: High Thermal Density Ambient Temperature Derating
rules.description: Processors exceeding high TDP (>270W) combined with high-wattage accelerators (>=350W) under air cooling mandate derating maximum recommended ambient temperature to <=25C (or <=20C) to prevent thermal throttling and configurator blocks.
rules.recommendation: Configure ambient temperature tracking to <=25C (or <=20C) rather than standard 27C/30C ambient baselines.

rules.name: High-Power Accelerator Secondary Riser Airflow Zone Containment
rules.description: Double-wide or high-wattage PCIe accelerators in standard 2U servers cannot be installed in Primary Riser bays due to thermal turbulence over power supplies; they strictly mandate Secondary Riser containment where dedicated cooling baffles and unobstructed airflow exist.
rules.recommendation: Inject Secondary Riser Kit (Slots 4-6) to accommodate double-wide/high-power accelerator and satisfy layout routing.

rules.name: Internal Storage Controller-to-Backplane Interconnect Cabling
rules.description: Pairing a dedicated internal RAID/HBA storage controller with front drive backplanes mandates matching high-speed internal data interconnect cables (Box 1/2 cables) and sideband telemetry cables.
rules.recommendation: Include dedicated controller-to-backplane internal PCIe/SAS data cable kit (Quantity matching active drive cage count).

rules.name: Modern 16-Pin GPU Auxiliary Power Pinout Matching
rules.description: PCIe Gen5 / 12V-2x6 high-draw accelerators mandate matching 16-pin (CEM 5.0) power cables; legacy 8-pin auxiliary power cables cannot be substituted and trigger hard factory blocks.
rules.recommendation: Select 16-pin (12V-2x6 / CEM 5.0) GPU auxiliary power cable kit matching accelerator power inlet.

rules.name: Dual OCP Expansion Slot Enablement Interconnect
rules.description: Tender configurations requiring a secondary OCP 3.0 slot (2nd OCP Gen5) mandate internal motherboard-to-chassis signal cable enablement to activate the rear secondary OCP port.
rules.recommendation: Inject secondary OCP Slot B enablement cable kit to provide active dual OCP Gen5 connectivity.

rules.name: Multi-Slot x16 Full-Height Primary Riser Bandwidth Matching
rules.description: Tender configurations specifying multiple x16 Gen5 Full-Height slots (Rear 2x16 FH) require upgrading the default primary riser (x8/x16/x8) to an all-x16 Gen5 Primary Riser Kit.
rules.recommendation: Upgrade default primary riser to all-x16 Gen5 Primary Riser Kit (3x x16) to satisfy tender 2x16 FH requirements.

rules.name: Rear Boot Storage and Tertiary Riser Mutual Exclusion
rules.description: In 2U enterprise chassis, rear-accessible mirrored M.2 boot storage devices physically occupy the Tertiary Riser bay (Zone 3); tertiary risers are strictly barred to prevent mechanical collision.
rules.recommendation: Rear boot storage devices physically occupy the Tertiary Riser bay; remove Tertiary Riser to prevent physical chassis clash.

rules.name: Data Storage Drive Preservation Invariant
rules.description: When customer tenders specify local data drives alongside storage controllers and cages, the configuration must preserve data drives and never produce an unexpected diskless proposal.
rules.recommendation: Customer specified local data drives; ensure exact drive count, capacity, and interface are provisioned rather than delivering a diskless chassis.

rules.name: True N+1 Power Redundancy under Accelerator Peak Load
rules.description: When server peak power draw exceeds 1,500W due to combined high-TDP CPUs and accelerators, 1+1 redundant power supply sizing must ensure each individual PSU exceeds full peak draw.
rules.recommendation: System peak load exceeds 1,500W; size individual PSUs (e.g. 1800W-2200W Titanium) so a single PSU sustains peak load upon power feed failure.

rules.name: Rack Rail Cable Management Arm (CMA) Completeness
rules.description: Sliding rail specifications requiring cable management arms must include matching articulating CMA hardware for structured 42U rack cable dressing.
rules.recommendation: Add 2U articulating Cable Management Arm (CMA) to match tender sliding rail with CMA specification.

rules.name: Storage Enclosure Unpopulated Drive Bay Airflow Blanks
rules.description: Unpopulated storage drive slots require drive blanks to prevent internal air short-circuiting and maintain proper cooling over active drives and controller canisters.
rules.recommendation: Order drive blank kits for all unpopulated drive slots in storage enclosures.

rules.name: Storage Enclosure Controller Redundancy
rules.description: Enterprise storage systems require dual active-active controller modules for high availability and failover.
rules.recommendation: Ensure dual storage controller nodes are provisioned for failover redundancy.

rules.name: Fabric Interconnect Uplink Transceiver Complement
rules.description: Interconnect modules or top-of-rack switches require matched optical transceivers or DAC cables for each active uplink port.
rules.recommendation: Verify all active optical uplink ports have matching SFP+/SFP28/QSFP28 transceivers or DAC cables.

rules.name: EU Ecodesign Lot 9 Platinum PSU CE Mark Enablement
rules.description: Deploying 94% Platinum power supplies on enterprise dual-socket servers under EU Ecodesign Lot 9 requires a CE Mark Removal FIO Kit for non-EU destinations or an upgrade to 96% Titanium.
rules.recommendation: Add HPE CE Mark Removal FIO Enablement Kit ($1 list) for global export or upgrade to Titanium PSUs.
